news.title: New minor risk - Earnings quality
news.body: The company has large one-off items impacting its financial results. One-off items were 22% of the size of the rest of the company's trailing 12-month earnings before tax. This is considered a minor risk. One-off items are incomes or expenses that the company does not expect to repeat in future periods. Examples include profits from the sale of a business or expenses from a restructuring or legal settlements. If the company's reported statutory earnings include a large proportion of one-off items it means they may be an unreliable indicator of its true business performance as the earnings were skewed by these incomes or expenses. This is currently the only risk that has been identified for the company.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹46.80 (vs ₹28.41 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹46.80 (up from ₹28.41 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹8.70b (up 36% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.23b (up 66% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 26% (up from 21% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 12% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 18% growth forecast for the Specialty Retail industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 55% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 67% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

news.title: Cartrade Tech Limited Announces the Launch of Super Series
news.body: CarTrade Tech Limited announced the launch of SUPER SERIES, a first-of-its-kind integrated solution for used car dealer partners that bring together the combined power of OLX India and CarWale on a single platform. The Super Series is built to help dealers accelerate sales, improve sourcing efficiency, and strengthen digital presence through a powerful mix of platform benefits, business tools, and recognition. CarTrade Tech powers one of India's largest and most trusted automotive marketplaces, serving 85 million+ unique visitors every month, partnering with over 12,000 used car dealers. This combination brings together the 2 million buyers and sellers for Used cars in India. news.body: Analysts have lifted their fair value estimate for CarTrade Tech to approximately ₹1,710 from about ₹1,083, citing a healthier long term outlook driven by higher expected revenue growth, structurally stronger profit margins, and a modestly higher terminal valuation multiple, even after incorporating a slightly increased risk profile.
